Konalan Musti ja Mirri has moved from its old location next to S-market to a part of the undoubtedly slightly busier shopping area of ​​companies like Motonet and IKH. The new M & M is basically a copy of the old one and follows the company's standard store model. As always, the store is clean and the staff is friendly. There is no store with the widest selection of dog food and training treats in Konalan, but you can find enough dog food and training treats.

My dog's coat was completely messed up. The head was left completely untrimmed. I only received a refund of 4 euros for a 85 euro trim. Several others have also said that my dog ​​looks absolutely horrible. I do not recommend this groomer. My dog ​​was reportedly frightened by the sound of the dog's blow dryer being blow-dried next to him. Other groomers elsewhere have had no trouble trimming my dog ​​and the results have been neat. It would have been fair to get a lot more in refund.
